title: Calibration-Aware Training + ELO Feature Injection to Break Brier 0.22 Barrier
estimated_improvement: 0.22 → 0.20 Brier (per MDPI Jan 2026 study showing LR at 0.199)
motivation: Jan 2026 MDPI study: Logistic Regression baseline achieves Brier=0.199 with team ELO + rolling form + shot-chart embeddings.
XGBoost achieves Brier=0.202 in same study — our tree ensemble at 0.22 suggests calibration gap, not model gap.
Top 3 features across all models: home_next, team_elo_5y, team_elo — these are rolling ELO features.
Training directly on Brier loss (vs accuracy/logloss) yields better calibrated probabilities.

proposals.name: ELO Feature Categories
proposals.description: Add 3 new ELO-based feature subcategories to engine.py: (1) team_elo_current, (2) team_elo_5game_rolling, (3) elo_delta_vs_opponent. These were the top predictors in the 2026 MDPI study.
proposals.implementation: Append to Cat44/Cat45 in features/engine.py. ~15 new features. Low risk.

proposals.name: Post-Hoc Calibration via CalibratedClassifierCV
proposals.description: Wrap each evolved model with sklearn's CalibratedClassifierCV (method='isotonic') after GA selection. The GA selects feature sets; calibration is applied at inference time. No change to GA.
proposals.implementation: Add calibration wrapper in predict_today.py and in the HF space evaluation loop. Brier-select best calibration method (sigmoid vs isotonic vs none).

proposals.name: Logistic Regression Meta-Learner
proposals.description: Add Logistic Regression as a candidate model in the GA alongside ExtraTrees/LightGBM/XGBoost. LR's linear nature provides better probability calibration. Use L2 regularization, C tuned by GA.
proposals.implementation: Add 'logistic_regression' to MODEL_CANDIDATES in HF space app.py with hyperparams: C in [0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0]. 4 new model slots.

proposals.name: Brier Loss as Primary Training Objective
proposals.description: For XGBoost/LightGBM, use eval_metric='error' replaced with custom Brier score objective. CatBoost already supports logloss which approximates Brier. This directly optimizes what we measure.
proposals.implementation: Custom objective function in model training. XGBoost: custom obj=brier_loss_grad_hess. LightGBM: fobj parameter.

recommended_next_step: P1 (ELO features) — lowest risk, highest confidence, directly backed by top-3 feature importance data from MDPI 2026 study. Implement in engine.py Cat46 + push to HF spaces.
cross_project_applicability: ELO-style rating features can be ported to political_engine.py as 'donor_momentum_score' tracking cumulative donation trajectory vs peers.
